description: Search Horizon Europe and every other EU funding call (grant topics) on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal by keyword. Returns the topic identifier to quote in an application (e.g. HORIZON-CL5-2026-09-D4-03), title, parent call identifier, submission deadline, status word (Open, Forthcoming, Closed), type of action, framework programme and portal URL. Answers "is there EU funding for hydrogen storage", "which Horizon Europe calls cover AI in health", "what LIFE or Erasmus+ or Digital Europe calls mention circular economy".

programme.description: Framework programme code, e.g. "horizon", "life", "erasmus", "digital", "eu4h". Supported: horizon, h2020, life, erasmus, crea, digital, cef, eu4h, cerv, amif, isf, smp, edf, rfcs, imcap, innovfund, emfaf, ucpm, i3, pppa, euba. A raw numeric frameworkProgramme id also works.

query.description: Free-text search over topic titles, descriptions and keywords, e.g. "battery recycling". Omit to list everything matching the filters.
